statements.label: supported
statements.text: Moving from the shoot down to the root, miR2111 controls rhizobial infection by post-transcriptionally regulating TOO MUCH LOVE, a suppressor of symbiosis, in roots.
statements.evidence: We show that microRNA miR2111 undergoes shoot-to-root translocation to control rhizobial infection through posttranscriptional regulation of the symbiosis suppressor TOO MUCH LOVE in roots.
statements.note: The abstract reports that miR2111 is translocated from shoot to root and controls infection through posttranscriptional regulation of the symbiosis suppressor TOO MUCH LOVE.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The amount of miR2111 that the shoot sends to the roots is set by soil nitrate availability.
statements.evidence: We show that microRNA miR2111 undergoes shoot-to-root translocation to control rhizobial infection through posttranscriptional regulation of the symbiosis suppressor TOO MUCH LOVE in roots.
statements.note: The abstract describes shoot-to-root translocation of miR2111 but never mentions nitrate or what determines how much miR2111 is translocated.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In Lotus japonicus, miR2111 promotes symbiosis, acting downstream of LOTUS HISTIDINE KINASE1-mediated cytokinin perception in roots and of the shoot autoregulation factor HYPERNODULATION ABERRANT ROOT FORMATION1.
statements.evidence: miR2111 maintains a susceptible default status in uninfected hosts and functions as an activator of symbiosis downstream of LOTUS HISTIDINE KINASE1-mediated cytokinin perception in roots and HYPERNODULATION ABERRANT ROOT FORMATION1, a shoot factor in autoregulation.
statements.note: The abstract calls miR2111 an activator of symbiosis acting downstream of LOTUS HISTIDINE KINASE1-mediated cytokinin perception and of the shoot factor HYPERNODULATION ABERRANT ROOT FORMATION1.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Together, miR2111 and TOO MUCH LOVE form a node that switches on feedback regulation, balancing rhizobial infection against nodulation events.
statements.evidence: The miR2111- TML node ensures activation of feedback regulation to balance infection and nodulation events.
statements.note: The abstract states that the miR2111-TML node ensures activation of feedback regulation to balance infection and nodulation.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Small interfering RNAs, like miRNAs, are loaded into Arabidopsis AGO1 in the nucleus before being exported to the cytosol.
statements.evidence: These findings lead us to propose a substantially revised view of the plant miRNA pathway in which miRNAs are matured, methylated, loaded into AGO1 in the nucleus, and exported to the cytosol as AGO1:miRNA complexes in a CRM1(EXPO1)/NES-dependent manner.
statements.note: The proposed model of nuclear AGO1 loading and export concerns miRNAs only; the abstract does not examine small interfering RNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Leptomycin B blocks the nucleo-cytosolic shuttling of Arabidopsis AGO1, which relies on nuclear-localization and nuclear-export signals in its N terminus, consistent with CRM1(EXPO1)/NES-dependent export.
statements.evidence: Here, we show that the N termini of all plant AGO1s contain a nuclear-localization (NLS) and nuclear-export signal (NES) that, in Arabidopsis thaliana (At), enables AtAGO1 nucleo-cytosolic shuttling in a Leptomycin-B-inhibited manner, diagnostic of CRM1(EXPO1)/NES-dependent nuclear export.
statements.note: The abstract reports NLS and NES signals in the AGO1 N terminus that enable Leptomycin-B-inhibited shuttling, diagnostic of CRM1(EXPO1)/NES-dependent export.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Arabidopsis AGO1 must shuttle between nucleus and cytosol for mature miRNAs to translocate and for miRNA-mediated silencing to take place.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, mature miRNA translocation and miRNA-mediated silencing both require AtAGO1 nucleo-cytosolic shuttling.
statements.note: The abstract states that both mature miRNA translocation and miRNA-mediated silencing require AtAGO1 nucleo-cytosolic shuttling.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Compared with nucleo-cytosolic AtAGO1, nuclear-only AtAGO1 carries the same 2'O-methylated miRNA cohorts but interacts more with the miRNA-loading chaperone HSP90.
statements.evidence: Nuclear-only AtAGO1 contains the same 2'O-methylated miRNA cohorts as its nucleo-cytosolic counterpart, but it preferentially interacts with the miRNA loading chaperone HSP90.
statements.note: The abstract reports identical 2'O-methylated miRNA cohorts in both AtAGO1 forms, with the nuclear-only form preferentially interacting with HSP90.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In leaves produced after leaves 1&2, a slight reduction in miR156/157 abundance yields an outsized rise in SPL proteins and significantly alters leaf morphology.
statements.evidence: a relatively small decrease in the abundance of miR156/157 in these leaves produces a disproportionately large increase in SPL proteins and a significant change in leaf morphology
statements.note: The abstract reports that in the leaves after leaves 1&2 a relatively small decrease in miR156/157 produces a disproportionately large increase in SPL proteins and a significant morphological change.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: From leaves 1&2 to leaf 3 there is a steep drop in miR156/miR157 abundance, followed by a gentler decline in subsequent leaves.
statements.evidence: miR156/miR157 decline rapidly between leaf 1&2 and leaf 3 and decrease more slowly after this point.
statements.note: The abstract states that miR156/miR157 decline rapidly between leaf 1&2 and leaf 3 and more slowly thereafter.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Sugar signalling drives the decline of miR156/miR157 abundance in successive Arabidopsis leaves.
statements.evidence: Vegetative phase change is regulated by a decrease in the abundance of the miRNAs, miR156 and miR157, and the resulting increase in the expression of their targets, SQUAMOSA PROMOTER BINDING PROTEIN-LIKE (SPL) transcription factors.
statements.note: The abstract describes the decline of miR156/miR157 across leaves and its consequences but does not identify the signal that causes it.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Although miR157 is found at higher levels than miR156, it affects shoot morphology and SPL gene expression less than miR156 does.
statements.evidence: miR157 is more abundant than miR156 but has a smaller effect on shoot morphology and SPL gene expression than miR156.
statements.note: The abstract reports that miR157 is more abundant than miR156 yet has a smaller effect on shoot morphology and SPL gene expression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Arabidopsis ago1, rh11 rh37 and ann1 ann2 mutant plants secreted less sRNA in their EVs.
statements.evidence: The ago1, rh11 rh37 and ann1 ann2 mutants showed reduced secretion of sRNAs in EVs
statements.note: The abstract reports reduced secretion of sRNAs in EVs in all three mutants.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: AGO1 and the RNA helicases RH11 and RH37 bind selectively to sRNAs concentrated in EVs, whereas the annexins ANN1 and ANN2 bind sRNAs indiscriminately.
statements.evidence: AGO1, RH11 and RH37 selectively bind to EV-enriched sRNAs but not to non-EV-associated sRNAs, suggesting that they contribute to the selective loading of sRNAs into EVs. Conversely, ANN1 and ANN2 bind to sRNAs non-specifically.
statements.note: The abstract reports that AGO1, RH11 and RH37 bind EV-enriched but not non-EV-associated sRNAs, while ANN1 and ANN2 bind sRNAs non-specifically.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Arabidopsis rh11 rh37 and ann1 ann2 mutants were more susceptible to the fungal pathogen Botrytis cinerea.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, rh11 rh37 and ann1 ann2 showed increased susceptibility to Botrytis cinerea
statements.note: The abstract reports increased susceptibility to Botrytis cinerea in the rh11 rh37 and ann1 ann2 mutants.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The RNA helicases RH11 and RH37 also help protect Arabidopsis against bacterial pathogens.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, rh11 rh37 and ann1 ann2 showed increased susceptibility to Botrytis cinerea, suggesting that RH11, RH37, ANN1 and ANN2 positively regulate plant immunity against B. cinerea.
statements.note: The abstract ties RH11 and RH37 to immunity only against the fungus Botrytis cinerea; bacterial pathogens are not tested.
